# Section 3 slack

About 26 KB of 0xFF after section 3, usable once the section end is raised.

**Category:** free space · **Address:** `0x605d4000` to `0x605da800` (runtime cached) · <span class="pill pill-released">Camera-confirmed</span>
{ .facts }

**Build:** [E-M5 Mark III firmware 1.7, build 1700](../firmware/em5-iii-1700.md) · **Cameras:** [Olympus OM-D E-M5 Mark III](../cameras/em5-iii.md)

Raise the section 3 end constant at 0x60045e1d (0x605da000 tested). Section 4 starts at 0x605da800.
